behaviour: The first read gate exempts the profile binding canary command only when its raw text is made of the characters shlex.quote leaves bare, spaces, single quoted segments and the quote splice it writes, so a command substitution, backtick, process substitution, glob, tilde or escape anywhere in the canary arguments is denied with the seat brief reason; a Codex code mode canary is exempt only when the whole program is one exec command call whose object holds the command key alone, optionally bound to a name and shown with text, so a concatenation, spread, second key, extra argument or statement beside the call is denied; the canary that scripts.profiles.binding.persona prints, the mounted literal form with its quote splicing and the same command in a code mode wrapper stay exempt.
